name: SAST Result Triage & Analysis
description: Triage, validation, and analysis of static analysis findings. Covers false positive identification, true positive confirmation via code review, severity assessment, de-duplication, and production of actionable findings reports from SAST output.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SAST result triage

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SAST output and the need for triage
evidence: Can explain why SAST tools produce false positives and false negatives
Understands finding severity levels and confidence ratings
Familiar with the triage workflow concept

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Triages basic SAST findings under supervision
evidence: Triaged SAST findings on at least 2 engagements under supervision
Correctly classified findings as true positive, false positive, or requires-review
Traced flagged code paths to validate data flow findings
Triage decisions reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently triages SAST results and produces actionable reports
evidence: Independently triaged SAST output on 5+ engagements
Consistently achieves high accuracy in true/false positive classification
Produces clear findings reports with code references and remediation guidance
Passed proficiency assessment on SAST triage

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles high-volume triage; identifies tool blind spots; improves triage efficiency
evidence: Develops triage playbooks for common finding categories
Identifies systematic false negative patterns in SAST tools
Correlates SAST findings with DAST and manual review results
Mentors junior analysts on efficient triage methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on SAST triage methodology; develops lab standards
evidence: Developed the lab's SAST triage methodology and quality metrics
Defines triage accuracy benchmarks and quality assurance processes
Published research on SAST tool effectiveness or triage optimization
Trains teams on SAST triage and analysis

assessment_methods.description: Triage a set of 50+ SAST findings with known ground truth and measure classification accuracy
Review of triage accuracy and report quality from 3 recent engagements
